messages:
Maria (Customer Success): Heads up — GreenLine reported a sudden drop in rerank recall immediately after we swapped their embeddings to embed-2-small last week. They say top-5 results contain irrelevant docs; previous top-5 recall ~0.86, now ~0.62. They want product help: patch, config recommendation, or prioritized fix. Examples below.

Maria (Customer Success): Query: "refund policy for subscription pause"
Expected: doc_id 12345 (policy page)
Actual top hits: FAQ about cancellation, blog post about billing, unrelated KB.

Ashley (Product): Can you drop repro steps, sample queries and the index size? We need to scope. If we can reproduce we can bake acceptance criteria.

Maria (Customer Success): Index ~120k docs, ~600k paragraph embeddings. They use Redwood hosted model "embed-2-small", reranker is "rerank-lite-v1" (our supplied reranker). Recall measured over a 200-pair eval set they provided. Current retrieval config: cosine similarity, pre_rerank_top_k=100, rerank top_n=10, similarity_threshold=0.75. Attaching 3 failing queries below.

Devon - ML Eng: Two quick q's: (1) Are embeddings normalized at ingest? (2) Exact dim for embed-2-small and any quantization on storage? Also paste one failing pair inline so I can run locally.

Maria (Customer Success): Failing pair (short):
Query: "How do I pause billing but keep my subscription active?"
Expected doc: subscription-pause-policy.md (contains phrase 'pause subscription, billing paused but account retained')
Top retrieved IDs: faq-cancel, blog-billing-tips, guide-upgrade-plan

Kevin (Eng): Is this clearly a model regression (embedding model swap) or could config drift cause it? If it's the former, rollback might be fastest.

Maria (Customer Success): It started immediately after the model swap last Thursday. Customer did not change client config. Looks like a model/regression signal.

Devon - ML Eng: Plan: (A) reproduce on a 2k-sample from their eval set and compute recall@k for embed-1-large vs embed-2-small; (B) compare cosine similarity distributions for known positives; (C) try simple fixes: l2-normalize embeddings, try dot vs cosine, and lower pre_rerank_top_k. If reproduction holds, propose rollback + AB test. ETA 3-4 days for initial repro.

Ashley (Product): OK. Please add to product backlog as a customer-impact bug. Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) Repro script demonstrating the ~0.2 recall drop on GreenLine sample; 2) If fixed, recall restored to baseline or better on their eval set; 3) Hotfix runbook (rollback to embed-1-large or normalization toggle) + customer comms template. Prioritization: P2, escalate to P1 if multiple customers affected. @Sanjay FYI for contract implications.

Sanjay (Sales): We have a renewal with GreenLine next month. They flagged potential SLA impact on support workflows. Need ETA so we can set expectations. If rollback is quick that's preferable. Please flag if we need an exec note.

Kevin (Eng): Short-term mitigation we can push as a support-config change: normalize embeddings at index time and reduce pre-rerank_top_k to 50 to reduce noise. We can apply per-customer patch. Snippet: ```PATCH /v1/indexes/greenline/config { "normalize_embeddings": true, "pre_rerank_top_k": 50 }```

Maria (Customer Success): GreenLine approved a one-off config change. I can coordinate the test.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied config change to greenline-index (canary) at 1893456833 by kevin. No errors.

Maria (Customer Success): GreenLine tried the canary. Quick check: top-5 recall jumped to 0.79 (from 0.62). They want a longer run but this is promising. Sending logs next.

Devon - ML Eng: Good signal. I'll run the full 200-pair eval across both models and the normalized pipeline. If normalization closes gap we can add an SDK compatibility toggle or auto-normalize on ingest. Also evaluate flagging embed-2-small as lower precision for rerank pipelines.

Ashley (Product): I created ticket PROD-embed-regress-1893456789 in the backlog, assigned to Devon, target milestone: next sprint. I'll draft customer communication and rollback plan.

Sanjay (Sales): Please cc me on comms. :thumbsup:

Maria (Customer Success): Thanks — I'll close the loop with GreenLine after we have the final plan and ETA. :raised_hands:
